topic: Helping a Parent Set Up a Phone

script.title: DAD'S NEW PHONE
script.scene_zh: 廚房餐桌 · 設定新手機
script.story_hook: A son helps his dad master a new phone.
script.intro_zh: 兒子幫爸爸一步步把新手機設定好。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we set up a phone together. Listen for patient how-to phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們一起設定新手機。留意耐心的教學說法。
script.outro: Coffee spilled, but the phone is finally ready.
script.outro_zh: 雖然灑了咖啡，手機終於設定完成。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat the setup phrases.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們逐句跟讀設定手機的說法。
script.char_a_description: a tall man in his early thirties with short brown hair, wearing a charcoal hoodie, dark jogger pants and new running shoes, slim build, friendly grin
script.char_b_description: a retired grandfather in his late sixties with neat white hair and thick eyebrows, wearing a brown quilted vest over a plaid shirt, dark trousers and brown loafers, upright posture
script.char_a_role: adult child setting up the phone

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey Dad, new phone day! Sit down.
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪ dæd nuː foʊn deɪ sɪt daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 爸，今天是新手機啟用日！先坐下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This little thing? Where's the keyboard?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈlɪtəl θɪŋ wɛɹz ðə ˈkiˌbɔɹd/
dialogue.zh: 就這個小玩意？鍵盤在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No keyboard, it's all on the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈkiˌbɔɹd ɪts ɔl ɑn ðə skɹin/
dialogue.zh: 沒有鍵盤，全部都在螢幕上打字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The whole keyboard? That glass seems thin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊl ˈkiˌbɔɹd ðæt ɡlæs simz θɪn/
dialogue.zh: 整組鍵盤都在上面？這玻璃看起來好薄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's tough, really. Come, let's start slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts tʌf ˈɹiəli kʌm lɛts stɑɹt sloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 其實很結實。來，我們慢慢開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow is my speed. What's first?
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ ɪz maɪ spit wʌts fɜɹst/
dialogue.zh: 慢就是我慣用的速度。第一件事？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set your code: six digits you remember.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt jʊɹ koʊd sɪks ˈdɪdʒəts ju ɹɪˈmɛmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 先設六碼解鎖密碼，要好記的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our anniversary? Seven-one-two-two… done?
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊɚ ˌænəˈvɜɹsəɹi ˈsɛvən wʌn tu tu dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 用我們的結婚紀念日？七一二二……設好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saved. Now the best part: bigger text.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪvd naʊ ðə bɛst pɑɹt ˈbɪɡɚ tɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 存好了。現在是最實用的部分：放大字體。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, please. Last week I squinted all Tuesday.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ pliz læst wiːk aɪ skwɪnt ɔl tuzˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 拜託。上週二我一整天都瞇著眼看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One slider, five steps up. Like—there.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈslaɪdɚ faɪv stɛps ʌp laɪk ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 一個滑桿，往上調五格。看——就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh! I can see without leaning in.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ aɪ kæn si wɪˈðaʊt ˈlinɪŋ ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 噢！我不湊近也能看清了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And now, the wifi—password time. Ready?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd naʊ ðə ˈwaɪfaɪ ˈpæswɜɹd taɪm ˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 接著是無線網路——要輸入密碼了，準備好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Um, the long one from the router sticker?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ðə lɔŋ wʌn fɹʌm ðə ˈɹaʊtɚ ˈstɪkɚ/
dialogue.zh: 呃，路由器貼紙上那串很長的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one. It's 'Sunrise' with a big S… then forty-two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ɪts ˈsʌnˌɹaɪz wɪð ə bɪɡ ɛs ðɛn ˈfɔɹti tu/
dialogue.zh: 就是那串。大寫S開頭的Sunrise……再接四十二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, big letters matter on these things?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt bɪɡ ˈlɛtɚz ˈmætɚ ɑn ðiz θɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 等等，這種密碼還分大小寫？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, sorry. Big S, then unrise, then forty-two.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈsɑɹi bɪɡ ɛs ðɛn ˌʌnˈɹaɪz ðɛn ˈfɔɹti tu/
dialogue.zh: 對，抱歉。大寫S，接unrise，最後四十二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunrise… forty-two… did that connect?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌnˌɹaɪz ˈfɔɹti tu dɪd ðæt kəˈnɛkt/
dialogue.zh: Sunrise……四十二……連上了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One second—nope, try again, mind the capitals.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈsɛkənd nop traɪ əˈɡɛn maɪnd ðə ˈkæpətlz/
dialogue.zh: 我看一下——沒成功，再輸一次，注意大寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm an old dog learning tricks, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ən oʊld dɑɡ ˈlɜɹnɪŋ trɪks hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 我這把老骨頭在學新把戲啦，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Old dogs learn slow but keep it forever.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld dɑɡz lɜɹn sloʊ bʌt kip ɪt fɚˈɛvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 老骨頭學得慢，可一學就是一輩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There—connected! Green bars, wow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹ kəˈnɛktɪd ɡɹin bɑɹz waʊ/
dialogue.zh: 有了——連上了！綠色的訊號條，哇！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the home screen. See those dots?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə hoʊm skɹin si ðoʊz dɑts/
dialogue.zh: 現在是主畫面，看到那些圓點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green ones at the bottom? Those are apps?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹin wʌnz æt ðə bɑtəm ðoʊz ɑɹ æps/
dialogue.zh: 下面那排綠色的？那些是應用程式？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes. Phone, camera, photos—your big three.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs foʊn ˈkæmɹə ˈfoʊtoʊz jʊɹ bɪɡ θɹi/
dialogue.zh: 對。電話、相機、照片——你最常用的三樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I move them? This one's too small.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ muːv ðɛm ðɪs wʌnz tu smɔl/
dialogue.zh: 我能換位置嗎？這個太小了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press and hold, then drag like a coin.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɹɛs ænd hoʊld ðɛn dɹæɡ laɪk ə kɔɪn/
dialogue.zh: 按住不動，再像推硬幣一樣拖過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look at that! It actually moved.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðæt ɪt ˈæktʃuəli mud/
dialogue.zh: 你看！它真的過去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're quick. Weather app next?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ kwɪk ˈwɛðɚ æp nɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 你學得真快。接下來查天氣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, don't flatter me… but yes, weather.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ doʊnt ˈflætɚ mi bʌt jɛs ˈwɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，別誇我……不過好，查天氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Search the box, type 'rain', that's it.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɜɹtʃ ðə bɑks taɪp ɹeɪn ðæts ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 在搜尋框打rain，就好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There! Seventy-two tomorrow. Water the tomatoes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹ ˈsɛvənti tu təˈmɑɹoʊ ˈwɔɾɚ ðə təˈmeɪtoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 有了！明天七十二度。番茄要澆水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dad, you asked me that at eleven.
dialogue.phonetic: /dæd ju æskt mi ðæt æt ɪˈlɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 爸，你上午十一點才問過同一句。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Details! Anyway, photos now, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈteɪlz ˈɛnɪˌwɛ ˈfoʊtoʊz naʊ pliz/
dialogue.zh: 細節最要緊。先來看照片吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This flower picture—yours, from Mom's garden.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈflaʊɚ ˈpɪktʃɚ jʊɹz fɹʌm mɑmz ˈɡɑɹdən/
dialogue.zh: 這張花的照片，是媽媽花園裡拍的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You set that as my wallpaper?
dialogue.phonetic: /juː sɛt ðæt æz maɪ ˈwɔlˌpeɪpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 你把這張設成我的桌面壁紙了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, small surprise. Do you hate it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm smɔl sɚˈpɹaɪz du ju heɪt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 呃，小小的驚喜。你不喜歡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hate? It's the first thing I see daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪt ɪts ðə fɜɹst θɪŋ aɪ si ˈdeɪli/
dialogue.zh: 怎會不喜歡？這是我每天睜眼看到的第一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, tricky part now: the SIM tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈtɹɪki pɑɹt naʊ ðə sɪm treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好，現在是麻煩的部分：電話卡卡槽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tiny hole? My hands shake, remember?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtaɪni hoʊl maɪ hænz ʃeɪk ɹɪˈmɛmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那個小孔？你記得我的手會抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paperclip here, gentle tilt—look.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪɚˌklɪp hɪɹ ˈdʒɛntəl tɪlt lʊk/
dialogue.zh: 迴紋針從這裡，輕輕一推——你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That pop! It slid right out, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt pɑp ɪt slɪd ɹaɪt aʊt hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 就是那聲輕脆的「啪」！它滑出來了，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Old card in, click. Your number lives again.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld kɑɹd ɪn klɪk jʊɹ ˈnʌmbɚ lɪvz əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 舊卡放進去，喀噠。你的號碼又活了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My number stays? That's half my life.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈnʌmbɚ steɪz ðæts hæf maɪ laɪf/
dialogue.zh: 我的號碼留住了？那是我半輩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Power off: hold the side button, three seconds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpaʊɚ ɔf hoʊld ðə saɪd ˈbʌtn θɹi ˈsɛkəndz/
dialogue.zh: 關機的話：長按側邊鍵，三秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold three… see, screen went dark. Magic.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld θɹi si skɹin wɛnt dɑɹk ˈmædʒɪk/
dialogue.zh: 按三秒……看，螢幕暗了。像魔法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same way to wake it. Now, one more thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm weɪ tə weɪk ɪt naʊ wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 喚醒也是同一招。爸，還有一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The thing you fixed before I asked, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə θɪŋ ju fɪkst bɪˈfɔɹ aɪ æsk taɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是你在我開口前就弄好的那件，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guilty. I saved emergency contacts already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɪlti aɪ seɪvd ɪˈmɜɹdʒənsi ˈkɑntæktz ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 哈，是我先做了。緊急聯絡人都存好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did all that while I hunted glasses?
dialogue.phonetic: /juː dɪd ɔl ðæt waɪl aɪ ˈhʌntɪd ˈɡlæsəz/
dialogue.zh: 就在我找老花眼鏡的時候，你全弄好了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: While you found the glasses, um, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪl ju faʊnd ðə ˈɡlæsəz ʌm jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 就在你找眼鏡的那幾分鐘，呃，對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sneaky. Can I call your mom to test it?
dialogue.phonetic: /sˈnikɪ kæn aɪ kɔl jʊɹ mɑm tə tɛst ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 調皮鬼。我能打給你媽媽試試嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She'll answer on ring two, bet you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃil ˈænsɚ ɑn ɹɪŋ tu bɛt ju/
dialogue.zh: 我跟你賭，第二響她就接。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dialing… ringing… hello, Linda!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdaɪəlɪŋ ˈɹɪŋɪŋ hɛˈloʊ ˈlɪndə/
dialogue.zh: 撥號……響了……喂，琳達！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put it on speaker so I can hear too.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ɪt ɑn ˈspikɚ soʊ aɪ kæn hɪɹ tu/
dialogue.zh: 開擴音，讓我也聽得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She says this phone finally suits me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz ðɪs foʊn ˈfaɪnəli suts mi/
dialogue.zh: 她說這支手機總算配得上我了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Last tip: cases save phones, trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ læst tɪp ˈkæsɪz seɪv foʊnz tɹʌst mi/
dialogue.zh: 哈！最後一招：保護殼救手機，信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, like my mug—oh no, look out!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt laɪk maɪ mʌɡ oʊ noʊ lʊk aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 說得對，就像我的杯子——噢不，小心！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it! I caught the phone, barely.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt aɪ kɑt ðə foʊn ˈbɛɹli/
dialogue.zh: 接到了！我差一點才攔下它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mugs stay far from gadgets. Thank you, son.
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌɡz steɪ fɑɹ fɹʌm ˈɡædʒəts θæŋk juː sʌn/
dialogue.zh: 杯子得離電子產品遠一點。謝謝你，孩子。

script.youtube_title_en: "Slow Is My Speed" — Helping a Parent Set Up a New Phone
script.youtube_description:
幫爸媽設定新手機，是一場耐心與笑聲並存的考試。這一集用60句自然英文，呈現兒子帶爸爸從零開始的餐桌教學：設定六碼密碼、把字體調大、連上家裡的無線網路、移動圖標、更換電話卡，再到一通打給媽媽的測試電話，最後以差點翻倒的咖啡收尾。

你會聽到：
- 耐心開場：「Slow is my speed. What's first?」
- 密碼唸法：「Big S, then unrise, then forty-two.」
- 動作教學：「Press and hold, then drag like a coin.」
- 溫暖收尾：「It's the first thing I see daily.」

這些說法涵蓋了怎麼放慢步調、怎麼提醒再輸一次、怎麼鼓勵長輩開口。後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧 先聽完整段對話，再一句一句模仿，讓句子變成口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

祝你教家人用新手機的那天，笑聲比咖啡灑得多。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱頻道，每週都有生活情境英文聽力！
script.youtube_description_en:
Teaching a parent a new phone is a patience test and a comedy at the same time. In 60 short A2 lines, a son walks his dad through everything at the kitchen table: setting a six-digit code, making the text bigger, joining the home wifi, moving apps, swapping the SIM card, and dialing mom for the first real test call. A coffee mug nearly ends the lesson early.

You'll hear gentle teaching phrases, numbers and passwords in plain English, small jokes, and warm encouragement, all in natural American speech with contractions and fillers.

The second half is line-by-line listening plus shadowing practice: listen to the whole scene, then repeat each sentence until it feels natural.

Made for A2 learners who want family English that sounds real.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new daily-life English listening video every week.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
爸爸的新手機要從哪裡開始？字體、密碼、網路、電話卡，一樣都不能少。

這一集帶大家走進週末的廚房餐桌，看著兒子把新手機一步步交到爸爸手上：放大字體、輸入網路密碼、拖移圖標、更換電話卡，還有那通打給媽媽的測試電話。

你會聽到：
🧩 耐心開場：「Slow is my speed. What's first?」
📶 密碼唸法：「Big S, then unrise, then forty-two.」
👆 動作教學：「Press and hold, then drag like a coin.」
💳 換卡聲音：「Old card in, click. Your number lives again.」

這一集同時示範怎麼重複說明、怎麼打氣，讓學手機的過程變成親子之間的溫暖回憶。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧 先把整段對話聽熟，再一句一句開口模仿，讓句子自然變成口語習慣。
